description: Compiles and runs Q0613A (06-13, embedded SQL SET OPTION/SELECT INTO/UPDATE/SQLSTATE/GET DIAGNOSTICS against TOKUIM) and Q0614A (06-14 'JUCINQ4S', cursor + multi-row FETCH + PREPARE/? dynamic SQL over TOKUIM/JUCHUM, standalone - NOT wired to the JUCINQ command). CRTSQLRPGI syntax verified directly against work/design/refs/cl_commands_75.txt's own parameter table (OBJ/SRCFILE/SRCMBR/OBJTYPE/COMMIT, lines ~4095-4127), resolving the P24-ladder manifest's earlier flagged uncertainty about whether SRCFILE/SRCMBR (member-based) is valid alongside SRCSTMF (IFS-based) - both are documented, separate, optional parameters. Both programs report via a program-described QSYSPRT printer file (not DSPLY), captured as spooled-file text via the same CPYSPLF-to-permanent-PF technique used elsewhere in Part 6's manifests. Q0613A's SQL7008 demonstration depends on TOKUIM actually being journaled, which P12 has not yet confirmed (docs/probes.md) - if TOKUIM is not journaled, the SET-OPTION-removed variant this lesson describes may behave differently than expected; this manifest only runs the SET-OPTION-present (safe) path, matching Q0613A's own default compiled behavior.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CPQ0613A
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0613A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0613A) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0613A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CPQ0614A
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614A) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0614A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
